authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: Create a Gaslamp Fantasy photograph. Show a fictional woman with facial appearance and short dark bob drawn from the supplied reference image, recognizably retaining its soft face shape, dark eyes, wispy fringe and jaw-length hair while inhabiting this invented scene. A supernatural presence interacts with the material world. Inside a narrow late-nineteenth-century instrument repair workshop, she has just finished sealing a crack in a large clear glass spirit bell mounted on a worn brass base. A translucent pale-blue hand rises from a small pool of luminous vapor inside the closed bell. Its index fingertip rests on the inner surface of the glass, exactly opposite her right index fingertip resting on the outer surface; the two fingertips meet through the same thin glass wall. A small six-point bloom of frost radiates from that shared contact, bridging the repaired crack. Her right elbow rests on the wooden workbench, her forearm reaches comfortably forward, and her left hand rests separately on the bench beside the brass base. She leans in with absorbed, gentle surprise, softly parted lips and a relaxed shoulder line, her visible face turned three-quarters toward the camera while her gaze follows the fingertip contact. She wears a charcoal fitted wool bodice over an ivory blouse with narrow gathered cuffs. An open repair case with two slim hand tools and a coil of sealing wire explains the work that has just ended. A wall-mounted gas bracket with its visible amber flame and a frosted window illuminate the walnut drawers, hand tools and uneven plaster. Frame a medium environmental portrait from the near corner of the bench, holding her face, both forearms and the entire glass bell together at readable size. The spectral hand, the human fingertip and their shared frost mark form one clear visual triangle with her eyes. Render the glass reflections, worn brass, natural skin texture and fabric weave as a tangible photograph; warm gaslight meets the cold light inside the vessel.
